verdict.rationale: Blaxel is a cloud platform for agent infrastructure, and such a platform could plausibly ship a built-in assistant, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows ways for the user's own external agents to operate Blaxel: an installable skill, sandbox MCP servers and a hosted MCP endpoint. Nothing documents a native AI assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to, so this is adjacent support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
